companies.name: OneSoil
companies.what_they_ship: Satellite-powered precision farming platform: NDVI/moisture monitoring, productivity zones, VRA maps, DJI Agras prescription-map workflows, AI agronomist, and global field/crop analytics.

evidence.title: Latest Releases - Variable-Rate Application Maps for DJI Agras Drones
evidence.note: Release says OneSoil Pro creates VRA maps using satellite imagery, productivity maps or soil analysis.

evidence.title: Latest Releases - Updated Moisture Indexes
evidence.note: NDMI, SMI and NDWI visualizations updated after R&D tests including European farms.

companies.fresher_fyp_should_signal: Show field-level satellite time-series engineering, VRA-ready exports, agronomic validation, and avoidance of generic NDVI dashboards.

companies.name: BASF Digital Farming / xarvio
companies.what_they_ship: xarvio FIELD MANAGER and related products for crop modelling, satellite-informed field zones, VRA maps, machine connectivity, bioenergy/carbon-intensity tracking and agronomic advice.

evidence.title: BASF launches next generation xarvio CONNECT 2.0
evidence.note: BASF lists FIELD MANAGER, Fruits & Veggies, AgBusiness, BIOENERGY and HEALTHY FIELDS; notes 140k users and 30M ha.

evidence.title: xarvio FIELD MANAGER
evidence.note: Product page linked from dated BASF launch; describes satellite biomass maps and Powerzone maps.

companies.fresher_fyp_should_signal: Evidence of agronomic model integration, map-to-machine workflows, and measurable input-use or gross-margin outcomes.

companies.name: xFarm Technologies
companies.what_they_ship: Farm management and precision-agriculture software with Satellite LITE/PRO, 14 multispectral indices, survey history, anomaly maps, prescription maps, drone/yield-map imports and sustainability/MRV modules.

evidence.title: xFarm release notes 10.1.0 - Satellite Crop Anomaly Maps

evidence.title: xFarm Precision Agriculture
evidence.note: Product page documents Satellite PRO, VRA creation, survey history and drone/yield-map imports.

companies.fresher_fyp_should_signal: Build a workflow that joins remote sensing with farm records, anomaly interpretation and compliance/export artefacts.

forcing_functions.name: EU Deforestation Regulation postponed application
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: Agri-food importers and exporters need geolocation, deforestation-risk evidence and due-diligence workflows; satellite verification demand rises around soy, cattle, cocoa, coffee, oil palm, rubber and wood supply chains.

evidence.title: Commission updates product scope and digital tools to support EUDR
evidence.note: Commission says EUDR applies 30 Dec 2026 for large/medium operators and 30 Jun 2027 for most micro/small operators.

forcing_functions.name: CAP Area Monitoring System monitorability rules
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: Member State paying agencies must turn Sentinel/geotagged-photo evidence into operational decisions, creating demand for explainable parcel-level crop, cover, mowing, tillage and eligibility markers.

evidence.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2202
evidence.note: Regulation discusses AMS scope and monitorable eligibility conditions from 1 Jan 2025.

forcing_functions.name: JRC/DG AGRI FIRE 2026 workshop: AMS, AI, drones and ELMS preparation
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: Official workshop report flags uneven AMS adoption, data gaps, need for pilot studies, AI, drones, Sentinel data and preparation for European Land Monitoring System in the 2028-2034 CAP.

evidence.title: The second FIRE Workshop (2026) report
evidence.note: JRC report covers IACS/AMS implementation challenges and ELMS preparation.

forcing_functions.name: JRC MARS monthly crop monitoring drought and heat alerts
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: Operational EU crop monitoring is publishing frequent drought/heat warnings; farm and insurer tools need near-real-time anomaly, stress and yield-risk interpretation, not just static season maps.

evidence.title: JRC MARS Bulletin - Exceptionally dry and hot weather threatens summer crops
evidence.note: Latest EU crop monitoring bulletin listed on the JRC MARS page.

forcing_functions.name: Copernicus High Resolution Layer Crop Types 2017-present
forcing_functions.why_it_creates_a_gap: A pan-European 10 m crop-type product lowers the baseline for crop classification; novel work needs harder deltas such as uncertainty, transfer, field events, or decision workflows.
